v50_4_empirical_extend_and_engineering_u.extend_30s_kasra_isolation_law: Every Remix > Extend window in Flow Music (Lyria 3.5) is ~28-30 seconds. Because the Choir learns [المُسْتَهَلّ] in Stage 1 Root as a 2-couplet antecedent-consequent phrase, placing even 1 couplet of [المُسْتَهَلّ] at the end of Step XB ([الكَسْرَة]) forces the Choir to finish the 2nd half of the Estehlal melody during the first 6s of the next Step XA ([النَّزْلَة]), overwriting line 1 of the Nazla. Therefore: Step XA (~21s) = [النَّزْلَة] only; Step XB (~24s) = [الكَسْرَة] only (3 vertical triplet lines + 1 closing couplet + parenthesized choral echo of that closing couplet); and the Grand Finale [المُسْتَهَلّ] gets its own dedicated Extend window (Step 6C, ~20s).
v50_4_empirical_extend_and_engineering_u.single_unison_root_estehlal_law: In Stage 1 Root, write [المُسْتَهَلّ] once (2 parenthesized lines, ~14s) rather than duplicating unparenthesized + parenthesized lines (~34s). This prevents canonical/polyphonic voice collision and keeps Stage 1 Root at ~68s so it completes 100% inside Producer Chat's Root window.
v50_4_empirical_extend_and_engineering_u.studio_vocal_clarity_anti_shouting_lock: Never put 'natural vocal rasp and sincere breaths' or 'Ritual Dammam' in the Sound prompt, as they trigger live Mawkib crowd-shouting samples (~30% probability). Use 'studio-recorded pure vocal clarity' instead.

v50_4_empirical_extend_and_engineering_u.vertical_kasra_triplet_layout_and_zero_c: Format the 3 short triplet hemistichs of every [الكَسْرَة] on 3 separate vertical lines (followed by the closing couplet on line 4 and its parenthesized choral echo on line 5) so Lyria 3.5 never skips the 2nd hemistich.

gates.name: Flat Spoken Reading Prevention
gates.failure_mode: Dropping rhythmic Thaqeel below 55 BPM or leaving '...' ellipses and raw Fusha Tanween causes spoken-word recitation instead of melodic singing.
gates.resolution_law: Lock Thaqeel sweet spot at 56-60 BPM (never <55 BPM for rhythmic tracks; isolate 0 BPM Rubato in a separate session), convert '...' to '..', compile Tanween phonetically, and enforce 3-4 words per vertical line.

gates.name: Harsh Screaming Distortion Firewall
gates.failure_mode: Tokens like 'wailing', 'screaming', or 'tear-choked' trigger clipped high-frequency vocal distortion.
gates.resolution_law: Ban 'wailing / screaming / tear-choked'; use 'powerful high chest-voice climbs, natural vocal rasp, passionate microtonal melisma'.

gates.name: Muddy Background & Prompt Bloat Prevention
gates.failure_mode: Long (>60 words) Sound prompts or inline EQ numbers cause muddy low-mid resonance around 400-500Hz.
gates.resolution_law: Keep Sound description strictly 45-56 English words ending with 'Pure Acapella No Instruments', and execute EQ (-2.8dB @ 450Hz, +4.5dB @ 2500Hz) post-generation via local scripts/hussaini_dsp_montage.py.

gates.name: Pop & Melodic Instrument Leakage Firewall
gates.failure_mode: Writing instrument names (even negated like '--no piano, guitar') or 'strings / synth / pads' leaks musical instruments into Latmiya.
gates.resolution_law: Ban all instrument tokens and negative '--no' flags; close every Latmiya Sound prompt strictly with 'Pure Acapella No Instruments' (or 'No Melodic Instruments' for Zanjeel).

gates.name: Zero English Vocal Readout in Lyrics
gates.failure_mode: Latin tags ([Chorus], [Verse], [Bridge]) or English directions inside Lyrics are sung aloud in an English accent.
gates.resolution_law: Purge 100% of Latin characters [a-zA-Z] from 'lyrics_arabic' and 'lyrics_register_verbatim'; use pure vocalized Arabic headers only ([المُسْتَهَلّ], [النَّزْلَة الأُولَى], [الكَسْرَة الأُولَى]).

gates.name: Melodic Drift & Stanza Anchor Lock
gates.failure_mode: Long horizontal couplets or missing refrain returns cause the melody to wander aimlessly.
gates.resolution_law: Enforce short vertical hemistichs (3-4 words, 6-9 syllables) and return to the 4-line (...) [المُسْتَهَلّ] congregation refrain at the close of every stanza.

gates.name: Reference Clip Mismatch & Ethical Emulation Gate
gates.failure_mode: Hardcoding foreign reference_clip_id UUIDs causes cross-account errors or forces incompatible syllable meters onto a previous melody.
gates.resolution_law: Keep 'reference_clip_id: null' by default, match Tor and BPM to the poem's prosodic Wazn, and emulate living Radood schools ethically via 45-56 word acoustic descriptors.

gates.name: Thin Tenor Timbre Ban
gates.failure_mode: Writing 'tenor' produces a thin Western pop voice lacking Husseini chest authority.
gates.resolution_law: Ban 'tenor' unconditionally; lock 'commanding deep resonant Baritone lead vocal' or 'thunderous heroic Bass-Baritone lead vocal'.

gates.name: Single-Dialect Vocal Tract Purity
gates.failure_mode: Declaring 'Iraqi and Bahrani dialect' on a pure Iraqi poem splits the model's phonetic tract between two regional accents.
gates.resolution_law: Declare ONLY the poem's actual dialect in Sound ('authentic Iraqi colloquial dialect' OR 'authentic Bahrani colloquial dialect') unless the poem is an intentional dual-dialect fusion.

gates.name: Zero Sung Stage Directions in Parentheses
gates.failure_mode: Putting performance instructions like '(بصوت حزين)' inside parentheses causes the choir to sing the instruction aloud.
gates.resolution_law: Reserve parentheses '(...)' exclusively for actual sung unison Raddada congregation lyrics; place all performance directives inside Section JSON fields.

gates.name: Word-Boundary De-Cliticization & Final Sukun Lock
gates.failure_mode: Attached vocatives/prepositions ('ياحسين', 'عالباب', 'هالحچاية', 'شصار') and unvoweled word endings slur adjacent words together.
gates.resolution_law: De-cliticize into 'يَا إِحْسَينْ، إِعْلَه البَابْ، هَلْ حِچَايَه، إِشْ صَارْ' and lock a crisp Sukun (ْ) on closed word-final consonants before spaces ('بَسْ إِمْسَحْ').

gates.name: Dialectal & Prosodic Tanween Compiler
gates.failure_mode: Orthographic Tanween symbols (ً ٌ ٍ) are misread or clipped at hemistich pauses.
gates.resolution_law: Spell mid-line Tanween phonetically with Noon Sakina ('عَينِنْ تِسِيلْ', 'أَمَانَنْ يَا'), convert pause '-اً' to '-َا', and place final Sukun BEFORE '..'.

gates.name: Fusha-Colloquial Clash & Mandatory Iraqi Prosthetic 'إِCْ' Clusters
gates.failure_mode: Unprotected initial clusters ('بچفك', 'عيوني', 'حسين', 'بمجلسك', 'بگلبي') trigger Fusha vowels ('bi-', ''u-', 'ḥu-') inside Iraqi poems.
gates.resolution_law: Lock Iraqi labial/pharyngeal/velar onset clusters with prosthetic Kasra Alif + Sukun ('إِبْچَفَّكْ، إِعْيُونِي، إِحْسَينْ، إِبْمَجْلِسَكْ، إِبْگَلْبِي، إِبْگَاعْ، إِعْلَه'), keep 'خِيَامْ' without prosthetic Alif (QC33), syncopated feminine nouns ('العَافْيَه، حَافْيَه'), and phonetic construct 'تْ' ('وِسَادَتْ رِيشْ').

gates.name: Unmarked Medial Diphthong Glides & Open Feminine Haa
gates.failure_mode: Placing Sukun on medial 'ي / و' ('حْسَيْنْ', 'خَيْرْ') or on final feminine 'ه' ('غَرِيبَهْ') causes abrupt glottal clipping or harsh '-HHH' aspiration.
gates.resolution_law: Leave medial diphthong glides unmarked ('إِحْسَينْ، خَيرْ، زَينْ، وَينْ، بَينْ، زَينَبْ') and keep word-final feminine Haa open without Sukun ('غَرِيبَه، حِچَايَه، خَرَابَه، سَبِيَّه').

gates.name: Rhythmic Crying Isolation Protocol
gates.failure_mode: Including 'weeping / sobbing / emotional weep cracks / majlis cries' in 54-132 BPM Latmiyas injects noisy background crying over the Radood's consonants.
gates.resolution_law: Ban all crying/weeping tokens from rhythmic Latmiya Sound prompts; isolate weeping exclusively to 0 BPM Rubato Minbar Na'i sessions on phrase-final vowel tails.

gates.name: 36-Term Anti-12TET Microtonal Firewall
gates.failure_mode: Phrases like 'legato phrasing', 'calm', 'serene', or 'wordless pharyngeal Ahaat vocal drone' flatten 24-EDO quarter-tones into Western 12-TET.
gates.resolution_law: Enforce the 36-term blacklist in Sound prompts; generate human Ahaat drones exclusively in local post-production via Rosenberg glottal pulses + formant resonators.

gates.name: Two-Channel Routing & Inline JSON RTL Firewall
gates.failure_mode: Pasting '{...}' JSON blocks directly into the Compose > Lyrics textarea corrupts Arabic RTL bracket ordering and causes English key readout.
gates.resolution_law: Send JSON strictly in Channel 1 (Producer Chat); keep Channel 2 (Compose > Lyrics) and 'lyrics_arabic' 100% free of '{...}' braces.

gates.name: Mandatory Collective '(...)' Estehlal Orthographic Lock
gates.failure_mode: Unwrapped [المُسْتَهَلّ] lines are sung by the solo Radood instead of the unison Raddada congregation choir.
gates.resolution_law: Wrap all 4 hemistichs of every [المُسْتَهَلّ] block in parentheses '(...)' before '..', while keeping all [النَّزْلَة] and solo [الكَسْرَة] lines unwrapped.

gates.name: Mandatory Per-Stage & Per-Section JSON Orchestration
gates.failure_mode: Outputting bare plain-text poem stanzas loses vocal register, 3D panning, Maqam, and choir handoff control.
gates.resolution_law: Every stage MUST be output as a complete Stage JSON object containing full 10-key Section JSON directive objects.

gates.name: First-Person Plural Clitic '-na' Splitting Lock
gates.failure_mode: Writing colloquial 1st-person plural suffix as 'ـنه' after Meem/Noon ('مآتمنه', 'يلمنه', 'أمنه') causes Lyria 3.5 to split the word and sing 'مِنَه'.
gates.resolution_law: Always write 1st-person plural suffixes after Meem/Noon with open upright Alif 'ـنَا': 'مَآتِمْنَا، يِلِمْنَا، أُمْنَا، قَايِمْنَا'.

gates.name: Upright Alif Maqsura & Active Participle Yaa Lock
gates.failure_mode: Alif Maqsura ('ى' in 'المعزى، أنعى') is misread as Yaa, and Hamza-on-Nabira ('قائم') triggers unwanted Fusha Nunation ('قائماً').
gates.resolution_law: Write open Alif Maqsura with upright Alif 'ا' ('المُعَزَّا، أَنْعَا، بِالدِّمَا') and colloquial active participles with Yaa ('وَالْقَايِمْ رَسَمْ، قَايِمْ').

gates.name: Geminated & Closed Monosyllable Vowel-Stretching Lock
gates.failure_mode: Unlocked closed monosyllables or geminated prepositional phrases stretch into unnatural extra syllables.
gates.resolution_law: Write 'هَلْ شَهَرْ الأَلَمْ' with explicit consonant Sukuns and lock geminated 'فّ' in 'فِي طَفِّ كَرْبَلَا'.

gates.name: CVC Noun Second-Consonant Damma Ban
gates.failure_mode: Placing Damma on the 2nd consonant of CVC nouns ('حُزُن، گَلُب، جُرُح، المُهُر') in fast/mid phrases causes awkward vowel rounding or misreading.
gates.resolution_law: Ban Damma on the 2nd consonant of 'حزن / گلب / جرح / المهر'; enforce Kasra or Sukun: 'وْ حِزِنْ عَاشُورْ قَايِمْ، وَ لَا لَحْظَه حِزْنَكْ خَفْ، يَا گَلْبِ اليِهِيدْ، وَ يَا جَرْحِ يِلْتَمْ، مِنْ ظَهْرِ المُهْرْ'.

gates.name: Tokenizer Lexical Substitution Firewall
gates.failure_mode: Subword tokenizer substitutes visually similar dialect words (e.g., reading 'يبچي' as 'يمشي').
gates.resolution_law: Use verified orthographic forms that lock exact phoneme decoding: 'يِبْكِي بِلَا شُعُورْ، مَقْطُوعَةِ النُّحُورْ، بِدَمْعَه مَا تِنْكَفْ، بِدَمْ'.

gates.name: Zero Negative-Overlap Phrasing in Sound Prompt
gates.failure_mode: Writing negative overlap instructions like 'with zero vocal overlap' in Sound description paradoxically primes the attention mechanism to generate vocal overlap.
gates.resolution_law: Ban all negative overlap meta-tokens from Sound description; enforce non-overlapping turns structurally via single-stanza 80s payloads and separate section headers.

gates.name: Mathematical Couplet Duration Calibration (11-12s Law)
gates.failure_mode: Ignoring the physical singing rate at 58-64 BPM (~11-12 seconds per couplet) leads to overcrowded stage payloads.
gates.resolution_law: Budget 11-12s per couplet at 58-64 BPM: 4 couplets [النَّزْلَة] (~46s) + 2 couplets [الكَسْرَة] (~20s) + 1-2 couplets [المُسْتَهَلّ] (~16s) = ~82s per generation stage.

gates.name: Unique Numbered Kaser Section Headers
gates.failure_mode: Using an identical unnumbered '[الكَسْرَة]' or '[الكَسْرَة وَالمُسْتَهَلّ]' tag across stages causes Lyria 3.5 to clone Stage 1's Kaser melody/lyrics instead of singing the new Kaser lines.
gates.resolution_law: Use two separate headers at the close of every stanza and number every Kaser uniquely: '[الكَسْرَة الأُولَى]', '[الكَسْرَة الثَّانِيَه]', '[الكَسْرَة الثَّالِثَه]', '[الكَسْرَة الرَّابِعَه]', '[الكَسْرَة الخَامِسَه]', followed by unnumbered '[المُسْتَهَلّ]'.

gates.name: Construct Cluster & Possessive Suffix Anti-Garbling Lock
gates.failure_mode: Heavy consonant clusters across construct/possessive boundaries ('وحرگت خيامك', 'ثارك بطه') get mashed into garbled syllables ('بت خريمك').
gates.resolution_law: Separate and vocalize construct/possessive clusters explicitly: 'يَا جَدْ ثَارَكْ أَبْطَا، وَ فَرَّتْ أَيْتَامَكْ، وَ حَرْگَتْ خِيَامَكْ، السَّلَّابْ گِدَّامَكْ، تِنْزِفْ أَلَامَكْ، وَ دَلِيلَكْ طَرْ'.

gates.name: Anti-Hallucination 'lyrics_register_verbatim' Lock
gates.failure_mode: Producer Chat LLM occasionally paraphrases or drops lines when extracting lyrics across nested section objects.
gates.resolution_law: Include a top-level contiguous string array 'lyrics_register_verbatim' in every Stage JSON containing that stage's exact bracketed headers and vocalized lines, paired with a strict verbatim registration command.

gates.name: Mandatory 80-Second Extend Time-Budget & Max 7-Couplet Single-Stanza Law
gates.failure_mode: Placing 2, 3, or 4 stanzas (14-28 couplets) in a single 80-85s Remix > Extend compresses 12s couplets into 2.5s (garbling words) and triggers premature [المُسْتَهَلّ] choir collision over the solo singer at second 47.
gates.resolution_law: NEVER exceed 6 to 7 couplets (ONE SINGLE STANZA: 1 Nazla + 1 numbered Kaser + 1 Estehlal) per Stage JSON payload. Generate each stanza in its own dedicated sequential Extend step (Stage 1 Root -> Stage 2 Extend 1 -> Stage 3 Extend 2 -> Stage 4 Extend 3 -> Stage 5 Extend 4).

gates.name: Four-Line Estehlal Block Cap & Doubled Opening Solo-to-Choir Handoff
gates.failure_mode: Placing 8 consecutive parenthesized '(...)' lines inside a single '[المُسْتَهَلّ]' block causes the solo Radood to sing the first 6 lines and the choir only the last 2.
gates.resolution_law: Cap every '[المُسْتَهَلّ]' choir block at 4 parenthesized vertical lines. For doubled opening Estehlals (Bujabara/Karbalaei school), structure Pass 1 ('[المُسْتَهَلّ الأَوَّلْ]') as unwrapped solo statement with parenthesized final refrain line, followed by Pass 2 ('[المُسْتَهَلّ]') as 4 parenthesized '(...)' lines for 100% unison Raddada choir delivery, with a 4s closed-lip humming bridge ('مممم...') before '[النَّزْلَة الأُولَى]'.

gates.name: Ban Orphan Single-Word Vertical Lines (Iso-Syllabic Balance Lock)
gates.failure_mode: Isolating a single orphan word or 3-4 syllable fragment on its own vertical line (e.g., 'وَ نَادَيتَه ..' or 'وَ لَاگَيتَه ..') breaks the Iso-Syllabic Lock, causes robotic syllable stuttering ('وَنَادَيتَه-تَه'), and triggers mid-track rhythmic/Rubato collapse.
gates.resolution_law: Keep every vertical hemistich balanced (6-9 syllables) or join balanced hemistich pairs cleanly with '..'; never isolate a single orphan word on its own line.

gates.name: Selective Prosthetic Alif Whitelist & Pure Kasra Preposition Baa Lock
gates.failure_mode: Prefixing prosthetic 'إِ' onto nouns like 'خِيَمْ / خِيَامَكْ' mutates the noun into the verb 'تِخَيَّمْ', and prefixing 'إِبْـ' onto 'ن/س/م/ك' swallows nasal/sibilant consonants ('إِبْنَهَرْ -> إِبْهَرْ').
gates.resolution_law: Restrict Iraqi prosthetic Alif 'إِCْ' strictly to empirically verified labial/pharyngeal/velar stems ('إِحْسَينْ، إِعْلَه، إِبْچَفَّكْ، إِبْچِدَمْ، إِعْيُونِي، إِچْفُوفَكْ، إِبْگَلْبِي، إِبْگَاعْ، إِبْهَيبَه، إِبْسَبِي'). Keep 'خِيَمْ / خِيَامَكْ' without prosthetic Alif, and use pure Kasra 'بِـ' before 'ن/س/م/ك/ال' ('بِالمَذَابِحْ، بِسْيَاطِ الحِقِدْ، بِالبَرِّ').

gates.name: Kaf vs. Gaf Homograph & Feminine Haa Boundary Lock
gates.failure_mode: G2P confuses standard Kaf (ك) with Iraqi Gaf (گ) in words like 'أَشْكَالْ' (misread as 'إِشْ گَالْ') or 'وَدَّعْتَكْ', inserts spurious 'كِـ' after open feminine Haa, or inflates final '-u' on geminated feminine rhymes.
gates.resolution_law: Lock explicit Hamza and Sukun on 'رِكْضَتْ أَشْكَالْ' and 'وَدَّعْتَكْ', separate open feminine Haa cleanly ('گَلْبِي مِنَ الهَظُمْ .. وَ الفَاجِعَه مَثْلُومْ'), and lock geminated feminine rhymes without final Damma inflation ('إِبْهَيبَه وَ عِزَّه / غُزَّه / مَعَزَّه / مِعْتَزَّه').

gates.name: Trim-Before-Extend Seam Discipline, 5-Track -14 LUFS Mastering & Canonical V50.0 GitHub Gate
gates.failure_mode: Extending without trimming trailing drift causes cross-stage word-bleed/vocal overlap at seams; uncalibrated EQ or version drift breaks 175-track spectral fidelity and CI validation.
